title: Close CRM Pricing in 2026: Solo, Essentials, Growth and Scale
summary: Close is $9 (Solo), $35 (Essentials), $99 (Growth) and $139 (Scale) per user a month billed annually, or $19 to $149 monthly. Calls are billed by usage.
body_markdown:
Close publishes prices for all four of its plans. Billed annually, Solo is $9 a month for one user, Essentials is $35 per user a month, Growth is $99 and Scale is $139. Billed monthly, they are $19, $49, $109 and $149. The Power Dialer starts at Growth and the Predictive Dialer is on Scale only. Calls, texts and phone numbers are billed on top by usage. There is a 14-day free trial. The pages were read on November 18, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every Close detail below comes from Close's own pricing page, help centre and terms of service, opened on November 18, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No Close account was used and nothing was tested. Prices are in US dollars. For the calling routes inside Close, see[how to make calls from Close](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-make-calls-from-close-crm) .


## Close pricing at a glance


Close's[pricing page](https://www.close.com/pricing) has a switch between annual and monthly billing, and its FAQ states both sets of prices. It says to talk to sales about enterprise needs and lists no enterprise price.


Close plans per user a month in US dollars, as listed on Close's own pricing page, read on November 18, 2026. Calling and SMS usage is billed separately on every plan. Plan Billed annually Billed monthly Users and seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


Solo $9 $19 One user only; up to 10,000 leads 14 days, no credit card Built-in calling, email and SMS, call recordings kept for 30 days. No Local Presence, call transfer, Power Dialer or Predictive Dialer


Essentials $35 $49 Unlimited users; no minimum stated 14 days, no credit card Solo plus Local Presence, call transfer and team reporting. Recordings kept for 30 days. No Power Dialer


Growth $99 $109 Unlimited users; no minimum stated 14 days, no credit card Essentials plus the Power Dialer, voicemail drop, call and meeting outcomes and Workflows. Recordings kept for 90 days


Scale $139 $149 Unlimited users; no minimum stated 14 days, no credit card Growth plus the Predictive Dialer, Live Call Coaching, advanced permissions and unlimited call recording retention


The page's own FAQ says Close has no free plan. The 14-day trial needs no credit card and includes calling and AI credits. The page also states a 30-day money-back guarantee on every new purchase.


Close's[Plans and Billing article](https://help.close.com/account-management/plans-and-billing) lists the same eight prices. It adds that a plan applies to the whole organization, so its users cannot be on different paid plans.


## What changes the real cost of Close


The plan price is public. The bill also depends on the billing term, calling and SMS usage, phone numbers, which plan has the dialer you need, and add-ons.


### Annual or monthly billing


Annual billing is $10 a user a month lower than monthly billing on Solo, Growth and Scale, and $14 lower on Essentials. Five Growth users come to $495 a month on annual billing, or $545 billed monthly.


The Plans and Billing article says Close offers discounts to customers with 10 or more seats who commit for 12 months or longer. The amounts are not published. It also says monthly subscriptions are paid by card only, while annual subscriptions paid by invoice can use a card or ACH.


### Calling minutes and texts


No plan includes calling minutes. The pricing page says calling and SMS usage fees are not included in plan costs. It says most outbound destinations are around $0.02 a minute and that rates vary by country. It does not print a rate table of its own.


Close's[usage costs article](https://help.close.com/account-management/variable-usage-costs-calling-sms-phone-numbers-ai-tools) says calls are charged per minute according to Twilio's pay-as-you-go voice pricing. Every call is rounded up to the next full minute, so a 70-second call is billed as two minutes. A forwarded call is billed as two calls. A call transferred to another Close user is billed as at least three.


SMS is charged per message unit at Twilio's SMS pricing, for messages sent and received. MMS in the US and Canada is $0.03 for each outgoing message and $0.01 for each incoming one. US texting also needs A2P 10DLC registration. The article lists one-time fees of $4 or $44 by brand type plus a $15 campaign verification fee, and a recurring campaign fee from $1.50 a month.


### Phone numbers


The pricing page says phone numbers cost from about $1 a month each. The usage costs article says the price depends on the country and the number type, such as local or toll-free. The cost is charged when a number is added and renews each month.


### The usage balance


Usage is paid from a prepaid balance of usage credits, separate from the plan subscription. Close's[usage balance article](https://help.close.com/account-management/variable-usage-costs-calling-sms-phone-numbers-ai-tools/managing-your-usage-balance) says the balance tops up automatically when it runs low, and that the default Monthly Spending Limit is $100 a month. The Plans and Billing article says a card must stay on file for usage, even when the subscription is paid by invoice.


### Which plan has the dialer


The plan comparison lists the Power Dialer on Growth and Scale. Close's[Power Dialer article](https://help.close.com/feature-guide/power-predictive-dialing/using-the-power-dialer) says it is not available on Solo or Essentials and cannot be bought as a separate add-on. So a team that wants to dial through a list pays at least $99 per user a month on annual billing.


The Predictive Dialer, which calls several leads at once, is on Scale only. Close's[Predictive Dialer article](https://help.close.com/feature-guide/power-predictive-dialing/using-the-predictive-dialer) says one person can use it, but that at least four people should be logged in to get its full potential. It adds that a rep dialing alone is unlikely to see the call rate rise above one call at a time.


### Add-ons and AI credits


- **Call Assistant:** a paid add-on on every plan that transcribes and summarizes calls. It costs $50 a month per account plus $0.02 per recorded minute.
- **Additional organizations:** $50 a month each. Growth and Scale include one at no charge.
- **AI credits:** 500 a month on Solo, and 1,000, 1,500 or 2,000 per user a month on Essentials, Growth and Scale. Credits do not roll over. The page says more can be bought and gives no price.


### Changing plans, cancelling and refunds


The pricing page says monthly plans can be upgraded, downgraded or cancelled at any time. Annual plans can be upgraded during the term, and a downgrade or cancellation takes effect at the end of the term. New seats are prorated. Close's[users and cancellation article](https://help.close.com/account-management/plans-and-billing/adding-and-removing-users) says a cancelled account stays active until the end of the paid period, and lead data is deleted 91 days later by default.


The pricing page promises a 30-day money-back guarantee on every new purchase. Close's[terms of service](https://www.close.com/tos) say all fees are non-refundable and that Close gives at least 30 days' notice of a price change. Ask Close which refund terms apply before you pay for a year.


## Who Close fits and who it does not


Close describes itself as the AI CRM for small and growing businesses, with calling, email, SMS and pipeline management in one place. The pricing page says Solo is for independent sellers, Essentials for teams selling together, Growth for teams ready to sell more and Scale for high-volume sales teams. Every plan can be bought without talking to sales.


That fits a small team that wants its CRM and its phone in one product, and is ready to keep its leads in Close.


Close is a weaker fit for a team that already has a CRM and only wants a dialer, because every Close plan is a CRM subscription. It is a weaker fit for a team that wants list dialing on the lowest price, since the Power Dialer starts at Growth. It is also a weaker fit for a buyer who wants one flat price for calling, because minutes, texts and numbers are billed by usage on every plan.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Close CRM cost per user?


Close's pricing page lists Solo at $9 a month for one user, Essentials at $35 per user, Growth at $99 and Scale at $139, all billed annually. Billed monthly, the plans are $19, $49, $109 and $149. Calling, SMS and phone numbers are billed separately by usage.


### Does Close have a free trial?


Yes. Close offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card. Its pricing page says the trial includes calling and AI credits. Close has no free plan, so an account pauses at the end of the trial unless a plan is chosen.


### Which Close plan includes the Power Dialer?


Growth and Scale. Close's help centre says the Power Dialer is not available on Solo or Essentials and cannot be bought as an add-on. The Predictive Dialer, which calls several leads at once, is on Scale only.


### Are calls included in the Close plan price?


No. Every plan has built-in calling, but minutes, texts and numbers are billed by usage. Close says most outbound calls are around $0.02 a minute and phone numbers start at about $1 a month. Calls are rounded up to the next full minute.


### Is there a minimum number of users on Close?


Close states none. Solo is limited to one user. Essentials, Growth and Scale are billed per user with unlimited users, and the help centre says no fixed number of seats is included.
